# The sheet was completed: what changed

*Generated by `src/00b_compare_sheet_versions.py` when the received sheet became the sheet in use. These changes are applied: the results in `reports/` come from the completed sheet.*

- **Sheet in use now:** `data/metadata_raw/received/G3 - mini project - TEmplate (2026-10-12).pdf` (received 2026-10-12; SHA-256 `fcf7513e8b62f7747653ff01a34f646eaaeab657dd8b21ecdf03a2490f87fc0c`), copied to the place step 00 reads.
- **Sheet before:** kept in `data/metadata_raw/archive/`.
- **Best results with the sheet before:** arousal_3: random_forest 0.476 (p = 0.022, after correction 0.198); valence_2: random_forest 0.595 (p = 0.120, after correction 0.958); arousal_2: random_forest 0.559 (p = 0.190, after correction 1.000).

## Summary

- 28 cells differ, for 12 participants.
- **Spoken words:** 9 blank words are filled in (Y2-053, Y2-071, Y2-073, Y2-074, Y2-076, Y2-077, Y2-078, Y2-079, Y2-080); 1 existing word is changed (Y2-046). Blank words: 9 in the sheet before, 0 in the completed sheet.
- **Ratings:** changed for 3 participants (Y2-076, Y2-077, Y2-080). A rating is the label the models learn from, so these changes alter the analysis itself.
- **Strikethrough:** removed for Y2-076.
- **Feeling text:** filled in for Y2-071, Y2-080.
- **Subject:** filled in for 10 participants.
- **Kapoy speakers:** 10 in the sheet before, 15 in the completed sheet. The word analysis will change.

## Where the changes come from, as the group reports it

Reported by the group on 2026-10-12:

- **Ratings:** corrected from the participants' answer forms, because the first sheet had typing mistakes.
- **Words:** filled in by a group member who listened to each recording.

The pipeline cannot check these statements. The answer forms of the participants whose ratings changed (Y2-076, Y2-077, Y2-080) are the evidence for the corrected ratings and must be kept.

## Still open

For 5 participants the word in the completed sheet is not the word in the name of the audio file (Y2-056, Y2-059, Y2-061, Y2-066, Y2-072). The listening review should settle these.
